d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains how the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is calling on the United States to match its privileged access to critical minerals with tangible investments rather than empty paper agreements. As the world's leading cobalt producer and second-largest copper producer, Congo plays a pivotal role in global technology and electric vehicle supply chains, which are currently dominated by China.
